title: WeChatExportPayload
description: Standard export snapshot payload emitted by wx-pad-exporter and homelab wechat-export-api.

exported_at.description: Timestamp when the export payload was generated (RFC3339 with timezone offset, e.g. +08:00).

from.description: Start timestamp of query window (RFC3339 with timezone offset).

to.description: End timestamp of query window (RFC3339 with timezone offset).

watermark.description: Cursor for incremental sync: the max message timestamp in this payload, or 'to' if empty. v1.1: when media enrichment is enabled and a batch contains not-yet-ready media, the server rolls this back to before that message so consumers re-fetch it. Consumers must not assume it is monotonically increasing.

sha256.description: Canonical SHA-256 hex digest of the chats array bytes.

message_count.description: Total number of messages included across all chats in this payload.

name.description: Human-readable display name for the chat (display name, remark name, or fallback chat_id).

chat_id.description: Native identifier of the conversation (e.g. wxid_xxx or xxx@chatroom). Mobile superset field.

display_name.description: Raw display or nickname before fallback. Mobile superset field.

is_group.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the conversation is a group. Mobile superset field.

messages.description: Chronologically ordered messages for this chat.

ts.description: Message creation timestamp in RFC3339 format.

sender.description: Sender display name or identifier (homelab provides display/我; phone provides wxid/self/我).

text.description: Plain text content, or raw XML payload for complex AppMsg cards. Baseline mode: media messages carry an empty string. v1.1 media-enrichment: voice messages carry the transcription and file messages carry the original XML with parsed Markdown appended. v1.2: image messages carry the truncated projection of media.ocr.text (<=2000 chars) when ready, otherwise empty string. NOTE: text may change over time for the same message - never use it as a dedupe or cache key.

note.description: Human-readable auxiliary description of the message (e.g. '语音', '卡片/链接/文件'). For image messages: '图片' when media enrichment is ready or baseline, or fine-grained status notes when not ready ('图片（处理中）', '图片（未下载）', '图片（动图）', '图片（超大）', '图片（不可解密）', '图片（解析失败）', '图片（无法定位）').

media.description: Optional media payload for enriched media messages (v1.2: images). Absent when media enrichment is disabled, media is not yet ready, or message has no media.

asset_id.description: Content-addressed MD5 hash of the decrypted image payload (stripped of _t/_h/_b suffix).

width.description: Image width in pixels, if extractable.

height.description: Image height in pixels, if extractable.

path.description: Relative storage path under vault root (e.g. media/<asset_id>/image.<ext>).

chat_name.description: Human-readable display name for the conversation, falling back to chat_id if unresolvable.

local_id.description: Message local_id in the message shard table.

dat.description: Relative source dat file path on disk.

text.description: Recognized text content from image OCR.

provider.description: OCR engine provider name (rapidocr, tesseract, mineru, none).

confidence.description: Average OCR confidence score (0.0 to 1.0), or null if unsupported by engine.

sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of decrypted plaintext image payload.
